video_title: A DAY IN MOROCCO WITH TACKO FALL - VLOG

quotes.speaker: Jaylen Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown and Tacko Fall reflect on their Moroccan travel experience
quotes.excerpt: You just got to dive in the culture, bro. You see, you got to experience life, you know?

text_blocks.speaker: Jaylen Brown
text_blocks.text: I had a great time, bro. You just got to dive in the culture, bro. You got to experience life, you know? The food, just dive right in.

text_blocks.speaker: Tacko Fall
text_blocks.text: I agree. It gets so crazy for me sometimes that I am just wanting to chill, but to experience things like this is good too.

quotes.speaker: Jaylen Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown and Tacko Fall discuss their friendship and travel dynamic
quotes.excerpt: This friendship is one-sided, bro. It's one-sided, bro.

text_blocks.speaker: Jaylen Brown
text_blocks.text: Today was a great day, though. Appreciate you guys sticking with us. I had fun. Tacko almost let me get killed by a snake.

text_blocks.speaker: Tacko Fall
text_blocks.text: No, I would never let that happen, bro. That's my brother right here.

text_blocks.speaker: Jaylen Brown
text_blocks.text: No, yes you would, bro. You would have laughed. If the snake would have bit me in the ass, you would have laughed and said I told you so. This friendship is one-sided, bro. It's one-sided, bro.
